name: Foam Roller IT Band Roll
steps: Lie on your side on the floor with a foam roller placed beneath the outside of your bottom thigh, supporting your torso on your bottom forearm.
Cross your top foot in front of your bottom leg and plant it firmly on the floor to control how much weight presses into the roller.
Roll slowly along the outer thigh from just below the hip bone down to just above the outside of your knee.
Continue rolling smoothly for the duration on one side, then switch to the opposite leg.
tips: Use your top foot and supporting forearm to offload weight if the pressure feels too intense.
Avoid rolling directly over your hip joint or the bony outer side of your knee.
